title: ByteSquadX
shortDesc: Enterprise-grade multi-agent AI orchestration platform built with React 19, Flask, and OpenAI GPT-4.
desc: ByteSquadX is a full stack AI platform for creating and managing autonomous AI agents that coordinate across complex workflows. Agents have memory, XP systems, emotion tracking, and real-time status monitoring.
desc1: Built the full stack architecture including React 19 dashboard with real-time updates, Flask backend with OpenAI GPT-4 integration, agent orchestration engine, and Firebase Firestore for memory persistence.
desc2: Core engineering challenges included designing the multi-agent coordination system, building real-time agent status monitoring, and implementing memory retrieval across agent sessions.

statusItem.title: Technologies
statusItem.desc: React 19, Flask, OpenAI GPT-4, Firebase, Python

descItems.title: Project Goal
descItems.desc: Build an enterprise-grade platform for orchestrating teams of autonomous AI agents across multi-step workflows.

descItems.title: My Role
descItems.desc: Designed and built the full stack architecture, agent orchestration engine, memory system, and real-time dashboard.

descItems.title: Key Features
descItems.desc: Multi-agent coordination, XP and memory system, role-based task assignment, real-time analytics dashboard, automated workflow management.

title: ResumeGenius
shortDesc: Full stack AI resume scoring and optimization tool using React, Node.js, and HuggingFace models.
desc: ResumeGenius is a full stack AI application that evaluates resumes using semantic analysis and keyword matching. It generates detailed ATS-optimized feedback for candidates.
desc1: Built the complete system including React frontend, Express backend, and a Python microservice integrated with HuggingFace models for semantic scoring and keyword gap analysis.
desc2: Core engineering work involved building the resume parsing pipeline, integrating LLM APIs for contextual feedback generation, and designing the scoring algorithm.

descItems.title: Project Goal
descItems.desc: Build a free resume evaluation platform leveraging LLMs and ATS-style scoring logic.

descItems.title: My Role
descItems.desc: Designed and built the full stack architecture, integrated LLM APIs, and handled semantic scoring pipeline.

descItems.title: Key Features
descItems.desc: Resume parsing, semantic matching, keyword gap analysis, skill suggestions, ATS score generation.

title: MeetingSense
shortDesc: AI-powered meeting transcription and summarization tool that turns recordings into actionable insights.
desc: MeetingSense is an intelligent web application that transcribes audio recordings and generates structured summaries, action items, and key decisions from meetings.
desc1: Built the transcription pipeline using Python and NLP libraries, designed the summarization layer using LLM APIs, and created the web interface for uploading and reviewing meeting outputs.
desc2: Core challenge was building a reliable pipeline that handled varying audio quality and produced consistent structured output across different meeting formats.

descItems.title: Project Goal
descItems.desc: Turn lengthy meeting recordings into concise actionable summaries automatically.

descItems.title: My Role
descItems.desc: Built the full pipeline from audio ingestion to structured summary generation and web interface.

descItems.title: Key Features
descItems.desc: Audio transcription, LLM-powered summarization, action item extraction, meeting insights dashboard.

title: Hiring Radar
shortDesc: Job market intelligence platform for tracking and analyzing engineering job trends using Python.
desc: Hiring Radar is a Python-based platform that aggregates and analyzes job market data to surface trends, track demand for specific skills, and identify high-opportunity roles.
desc1: Built the data collection pipeline, job aggregation logic, trend analysis engine, and visualization layer to surface actionable job market intelligence.
desc2: Designed to solve a real problem — understanding which skills and roles are actually in demand versus what the market claims.

descItems.title: Project Goal
descItems.desc: Build a job market intelligence tool that surfaces real demand trends for engineering roles and skills.

descItems.title: My Role
descItems.desc: Built the full pipeline from data collection to trend analysis and visualization.

descItems.title: Key Features
descItems.desc: Job aggregation, skill demand tracking, trend visualization, role opportunity scoring.

title: Healthcare ETL Pipeline
shortDesc: Production-grade ETL pipeline for healthcare appointment data using medallion architecture.
desc: Implements a robust Extract-Transform-Load pipeline for healthcare appointment data following the medallion architecture pattern with bronze, silver, and gold layers for progressive data refinement.
desc1: Built the full pipeline including raw ingestion, transformation logic, data quality checks, and a Streamlit analytics dashboard for visualizing appointment trends.
desc2: Designed around real healthcare data engineering patterns with automated quality controls and layered data processing.

statusItem.title: Technologies
statusItem.desc: Python, SQL, Pandas, Streamlit, Medallion Architecture

descItems.title: Project Goal
descItems.desc: Build a production-grade ETL pipeline following real data engineering best practices for healthcare data.

descItems.title: My Role
descItems.desc: Designed and built the full medallion architecture pipeline with automated quality controls and analytics dashboard.

descItems.title: Key Features
descItems.desc: Bronze/silver/gold data layers, automated quality checks, SQL transformations, Streamlit dashboard, pipeline scheduling.
